sections.heading: Data Collection
sections.body: The Bake Log is fully offline and stores all your data locally on your device. We do not collect, transmit, or store your personal data on any servers.

sections.heading: What Data Is Stored
sections.body: Your recipes, bake sessions, and starter logs are stored in a local SQLite database on your device. This data never leaves your phone.

sections.heading: Analytics & Crash Reporting
sections.body: Firebase Crashlytics may collect anonymized crash reports to help us improve app stability. No personal data is included in these reports.

sections.heading: Ads
sections.body: Google AdMob may collect limited data for ad targeting on the free tier. Upgrade to Premium to remove all ads.

sections.heading: In-App Purchases
sections.body: Purchases are processed through Google Play (Android) or Apple App Store (iOS). We do not handle payment data directly.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: All your data is yours. You can export or delete it anytime by uninstalling the app. We have no central record of your data.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For questions or concerns, contact: admin@eritech.studio
